title: IdiomX：多语言习语理解、检索与解释基准
summary: IdiomX是一个大规模多语言习语基准，包含19万+上下文示例和1.2万+习语，覆盖英语、阿拉伯语和法语。它定义了四个任务：习语检测、上下文到习语检索、阿拉伯语到英语习语检索和习语解释。实验表明，上下文Transformer模型改进了习语检测，混合检索和重排序架构增强了单语和跨语言习语检索。
summary_en: IdiomX is a large-scale multilingual idiom benchmark with over 190K contextualized examples and 12K+ idioms across English, Arabic, and French. It defines four tasks: idiom detection, context-to-idiom retrieval, Arabic-to-English idiom retrieval, and idiom interpretation. Experiments show that contextual transformer models improve idiom detection, while hybrid retrieval and reranking architectures enhance both monolingual and cross-lingual idiom retrieval.
